name: mother_project_resume
description: Resume a named project across harnesses. Matches the project name and owner-registered aliases in visible titles or text. Returns the latest confirmed decision, active checkpoint, open task and up to three new-to-you or revised records, each with its source ID. Null means no matching evidence. Before contains an authorized earlier revision when available. After presenting changes, pass their seen values to mother_mark_project_seen. Repeat for remaining changes.

name: mother_mark_project_seen
description: Save the listed revisions as seen for this credential and project after showing them. Copy workspaceId, generation, project and the seen pairs from the brief. Repeating an acknowledgement is safe. Updates only private reading positions.

name: mother_find_moment
description: Find up to three authorized accounts from distinctive words in a clue. Results report the words that matched, the time saved and any owner-recorded event date. Resolve the account and explicitly linked records by ID. Approved image handles need separate media access. Only set includeKeepsakes when the user explicitly asks to search keepsakes.
